data.selected_experiment: Section 4 / Table 3, the diversified 12-month time series momentum (TSMOM) strategy with a 1-month holding period across 58 futures contracts, January 1985 to December 2009
cannot_implement_reasons: Requires futures and forward contracts (commodity, equity index, government bond futures and currency forwards), which are non-equity instruments
Requires several asset classes at once (commodities, currencies, equity indexes and government bonds are pooled in one diversified portfolio)

economic_rationale.value: Consistent with sentiment theories of initial under-reaction and delayed over-reaction

evidence.quote: consistent with sentiment theories of initial under-reaction and delayed over-reaction.

universe_and_filters.value: 58 liquid futures and forward contracts: 24 commodities, 12 cross-currency pairs (nine underlying currencies), nine developed equity indexes and 13 developed government bond futures; data January 1965 to December 2009, strategy evaluated from January 1985; no further filters stated
